label: 후원
note: NOT row-based: a landscape with 2 disconnected alpha components (west/central mega-cluster vs east jangdokdae+rockery) and classify() is unusable for material segmentation here (WOOD/TILE thresholds fire on 66% of opaque pixels from autumn foliage color alone -- confirmed by research agent, see docs/assets/prompts b1b2 geometry reports). Regions below were hand-placed rectangles verified by direct visual inspection of gridded 3x crops (not classify() output). Jangdokdae jars are folded into stage 1 alongside their stone platform (not split out) since a clean jar-free crop would need per-pixel material masking that classify() cannot provide reliably for this asset -- ceremonial jars are a defensible part of the garden's early hardscape rather than a late addition. Zero generation cost: all 3 stages are pure crops/subtractions of the finished PNG.
